allocation.question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance capability be made DURABLE and PROMOTABLE in the shipping kernel path (src/spider) -- a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate showing that the SHIPPED kernel executes an inherited parameterized mechanism (known-positive: induction observation -> parameterized distillation -> resolve to EXECUTABLE with a correctly bound, non-null action -> execute against the fixture -> verify) AND refuses a known-negative binding (missing-parameter / out-of-support / wrong-intent) with a recorded reason and a null action, with unit tests, an accounting check that the inherited-path counters increment, and the kernel identity bound at freeze -- so the carrier actually lands in main through the pinned Product promotion path without manually copying experiment code?
allocation.rationale: This is open blocker B1 and readiness condition (1), the highest-leverage item in the program. I verified the blocker at source this cycle: main's src/spider/kernel.py still exposes only literal distill() with confidence=0.5 (line ~90) and no distill_parameterized(), while EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064 (audit PASS) showed the parameterized distill -> resolve -> execute path is live, causally attributable and honestly accounted on a real credential-free HTTP substrate outside the synthetic fixture. The arm-differentiation certificate (EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128) established liveness/selectivity on a synthetic fixture but never promoted to main. Until the richer audited carrier survives the pinned promotion path, no four-arm benchmark can attribute any effect to the shipped treatment, and the promotion contract forbids manually copying experiment code. This is also directly actionable Product code scope.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Canonical corpus 434 experiments across 10 claims. SPIDER still has NOT demonstrated a universal Web Physics and has NOT demonstrated the decisive product claim that a real external LLM agent pays materially less end-to-end cost per successful partially-novel Web task because it inherits mechanisms instead of redoing the task. The program has nevertheless converged on a sharper architecture: persist/reuse procedures and parameterized mechanisms, re-observe unstable values, and persist ephemeral state only where re-acquisition cost is genuinely material. The portfolio is currently well-aligned with the priority order in PROGRAM_AUDIT_2026-10-10.md: Product owns blocker B1 (land the audited parameterized carrier in the shipped kernel), Runtime owns B2 (certify a task bank with genuine comparator dynamic range), Intel owns B3 (settle the credential-free capable-endpoint question or close/re-scope it), Graph owns the C-FRESHNESS D1V constructibility kill-switch, Frontier owns site-native discovery versus apparent depth cost, and Physics owns the frozen access-barrier onset/recovery observable. NEW OBSERVATION THIS CYCLE (execution state, not science): four pre-freeze experiments (product EXP-PRODUCT-38047739799, runtime EXP-RUNTIME-38040090263, intel EXP-INTEL-38013769440, frontier EXP-FRONTIER-38013774272) all failed at the independent DESIGN REVIEW stage with the identical failure fingerprint 3b9ff5e4e9e73f23e368efb4 and the same provider opencode/exo-free, exit_code=1, category=substantive. In three of those lanes the DESIGN model (opencode/big-pickle) had already returned success; only the review provider crashed. This is a shared operational/provider failure of the pre-freeze satisfiability review, NOT a scientific rejection and NOT evidence about any claim; it must not be read as a negative result or as a reason to churn scientifically sound mandates. Physics EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068 is genuinely FROZEN (frozen_at 2026-10-10T11:10:26Z, pre_execute checkpoint, run 38046506410) and is completed under its frozen design before any redirection. Graph EXP-GRAPH-38046502943 is PREFREEZE with spec.json and prereg.md present and no freeze/design-failure record; its in-flight DESIGN is resumed. READINESS DISCIPLINE: none of the three expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON readiness conditions holds in current accepted evidence (no shipped pre-freeze-executable parameterized carrier plus known-negative refusal; no non-ceiling cold/retrieval bank; no proven same-model multi-step Web-agent driver), so the Director keeps Product/Runtime/Intel on blocker-removal and funds NO full four-arm benchmark this cycle. The five living lanes are already carrying the correct blockers; the correct global action is to preserve the frozen transaction and resume the pre-freeze mandates rather than manufacture a pivot.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (model unavailable rc=124; external_directional_context=[], spider_evidence=[], cross_lane_dependencies=[]). Its brief contains no independent reconnaissance: every candidate_direction is either a verbatim restatement of the in-flight lane mandate/handoff or a generic 'reassess whether claim X is now highest-value' prompt. I therefore treated it as staff advice with no evidentiary weight and did NOT use it to justify any pivot. Direction was re-derived directly from the machine snapshot, codex/claim_state.json effective_event_by_claim, research/claims/registry.json, the dated program audit, and the exact in-flight packets on the lab2/<lane> branches (request.json director_mandate, spec.json, freeze.json, failure.json). Because the Scout supplied no external competitor/dataset/prior-art signal, no additional Intel deep-verification task was warranted beyond Intel's own live endpoint question; if a future non-degraded Scout surfaces an external artifact that could change a live claim, that should be routed to Intel for verification rather than acted on.
